pairs.question: Nam quis inexpleto rumpentem pectora questu complexumque rogos incumbentemque favillis aspiciens non aut primaevae funera plangi, coniugis aut nati modo pubescentia credat ora rapi flammis?
pairs.derivation: Authorial rhetorical question (quis ... non ... credat ...?) about who, seeing such grief, would not suppose a youth, spouse, or son was being mourned. The poet answers it himself in the very next sentence: 'pater est qui fletur' (it is a father who is wept for). Answer window ends at the full stop after 'fletur'; what follows ('adeste dique hominesque sacris...') turns from answering to invocation. The verse line-numbers (10) fall outside the quoted spans; no scaffolding inside either field.
